name: Can AKN Design Group integrate a new pantry into an existing kitchen layout, or is it only for full kitchen remodels?

mainEntity.name: Can AKN Design Group integrate a new pantry into an existing kitchen layout, or is it only for full kitchen remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in both integrating new pantries into existing kitchen layouts and incorporating them as part of a full kitchen renovation. Our integrated design-build process allows us to assess your current space and recommend solutions that either adapt existing areas or reconfigure your kitchen entirely for optimal pantry placement and functionality. Whether it's a dedicated walk-in pantry or a sophisticated cabinet pantry, our goal is to create a seamless, customized renovation that meets your needs. We are adept at structural integration and ensuring consistent finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, AKN Design Group can integrate a new pantry into an existing kitchen or include it as part of a full kitchen remodel, ensuring seamless integration and consistent finishes.
